title: Newton's Method
text: The formula for Newton's Method is given by $$x_{n+1}=x_n-\frac{f(x_n)}{f'(x_n)}$$. $$Remember$$ $$that$$ $$Newton's$$ $$method$$ $$is$$ $$used$$ $$to$$ $$converge$$ $$on$$ $$roots$$ $$of$$ $$f(x)$$. $$If$$ $$you$$ $$applied$$ $$it$$ $$to$$ $$f'(x)$$ $$instead$$, $$it$$ $$would$$ $$therefore$$ $$find$$ $$where$$ $$f'(x)=0$$, $$or$$ $$the$$ $$local$$ $$extrema$$.
